_source: Not a capture, and not in Zoho Desk's OpenAPI files: the token endpoint belongs to Zoho Accounts. The success keys are the ones the OMS reads in production (em-biz-backend zoho/zoho_api_client.py, get_new_token: access_token, token_type, expires_in). The error bodies are the ones the design names (spec 2026-10-05, section 1: 'Access Denied' with HTTP 200 when throttling, invalid_code, invalid_client, invalid_client_secret). Values are fake. scripts/zoho/probe.py replaces the refresh answer with a masked capture and keeps the error bodies, which no probe run meets (spec 2026-10-05, part 1).
